summary: Iter-38 (5 enhancements: monthly cost trend, board labour totals, prohibition follow-up pack, vehicle cost card on Fleet, expensive-vehicle high_cost flag) fully verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 9/9 PASS: (1) GET /api/maintenance/costs/monthly?months=12 → exactly 12 chronological rows, last row = current YYYY-MM, shape {month, job_cards, service, repairs, total}; seeded two job cards in different months and both months' totals reflected (300 this month + 180 two months ago). (2) GET /api/maintenance/costs adds totals.avg_cost_per_mile + per-row high_cost — seeded regA (£1050 / 1000mi = £1.05/mi) vs regB (£100 / 10000mi = £0.01/mi); rowA.high_cost=true, rowB.high_cost=false, avg>0. (3) GET /api/prohibitions/pack returns 200, application/pdf, %PDF- header, >500 bytes; cleared prohibitions excluded. (4) Regression: costs no-filter, costs 1999 out-of-range window returns total=0 avg_cpm=None, /reports/prohibitions PDF still works, /alerts 200, PUT /job-cards/{id}/status rejects invalid status with 400. Frontend Playwright end-to-end: Dashboard shows monthly-trend + monthly-trend-chart data-testids and 'Monthly spend — last 12 months' subtitle; Maintenance Spend by Vehicle cost-per-mile-row for HZUI01 shows 'HIGH' badge (data-testid high-cost-badge) with £1.05/mi vs LZUI01 £0.01/mi. Fleet /vehicles table shows Maintenance column with data-testid vehicle-cost-cell per row; HZUI01 row renders '£1,050' + '£1.05/mi' + red vehicle-high-cost-badge icon, LZUI01 renders '£100' + '£0.01/mi' no badge, vehicles without maintenance data show '—'. Prohibitions tab (/vehicles → Prohibitions) shows prohibitions-pack-button when an open prohibition exists; button disappears after we DELETE the last open prohibition. Job Cards board view: column header data-testid=board-col-meta-open shows '3 jobs · 6.5h' (labour hours = 4 + 2.5 from the two HZUI01 seeded cards, correctly summed), in_progress/completed show '0 jobs' (no · Xh when labour_hours=0). All seeded records (2 vehicles, 3 job cards, 4 fuel fills, 1 prohibition) deleted in teardown — verified 200 on every DELETE and open prohibitions remaining = 0 post-cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5395 lines and still monolithic — same complaint from iter34-37. maintenance/, prohibitions/, job_cards/ modules would materially improve readability and test surface.

GET /api/maintenance/costs/monthly builds the month keys with a raw Python loop and never checks that months>=1 after clamping — Query(12) default is fine but rendered months=0 in URL is silently coerced to 1. Consider Query(12, ge=1, le=36) to make FastAPI validate.

avg_cost_per_mile is computed as a simple mean of per-vehicle cost_per_mile — vehicles with widely-different mileage weights are treated equally. This is acceptable for the 'high cost' flag heuristic but may surprise operators with many low-mileage vehicles; a mileage-weighted average would be more accurate.
high_cost threshold is hard-coded at 1.5× avg in server.py (line ~3899). Externalising as an env var (COST_HIGH_MULTIPLIER) would let operators tune without redeploy.

GET /api/prohibitions/pack loops attachments per prohibition and merges files, but there's no cap on total attachments — could generate very large PDFs and OOM on large fleets. Add MAX_PACK_ATTACHMENTS guard.

prohibitions/pack includes cleared==anything that's not literally 'cleared' — verify this includes new statuses (advisory, none). Currently `status: {$ne: 'cleared'}` behaves as an implicit whitelist-by-exclusion, which is fragile if new statuses are added.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest self-seeds & self-cleans. UI test seeded via curl: 2 vehicles (HZUI01/LZUI01), 3 job cards, 4 diesel fuel fills (odo 10000/11000 for HZUI01, 20000/30000 for LZUI01), 1 open prohibition (TEST-UI38). All deleted; verified 0 open prohibitions remain post-cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-38 batch is fully green. Key confirmed behaviours: (a) /api/maintenance/costs/monthly returns rows chronologically with the CURRENT month last, months clamp is max(1,min(36,months)). (b) /api/maintenance/costs adds totals.avg_cost_per_mile (mean of non-null per-row cost_per_mile, null when no vehicle has miles>0) AND per-row high_cost = bool(avg && cpm && cpm > 1.5*avg); rows with cost_per_mile=null always have high_cost=false. (c) /api/prohibitions/pack ALWAYS returns 200 PDF even with zero open prohibitions (still renders the Overview section) — the UI hides the button in that case (data-testid prohibitions-pack-button rendered only when openCount>0), so DO NOT rely on 4xx from the endpoint to detect empty state. (d) Job Cards board is at Maintenance → Job Cards tab (NOT /job-cards route); switch to Board view via the icon-toggle to the left of 'Report'/'New Job Card' — after switching, columns render data-testid=board-col-meta-{open|in_progress|completed} with 'N jobs' and ' · Xh' suffix when the column's cards sum labour_hours>0. (e) Fleet Maintenance column reads /api/maintenance/costs on VehiclesPanel load — freshly added vehicles show '—' until a job card is raised OR fuel is logged; with maintenance but no fuel span it shows the £ total + 'no mileage'.
